text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"--"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- (English) 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is marked '--' while note N1 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth, creating ambiguity about whether the part requires heat treatment. The designer should update the title block heat treatment field to reference note N1 or state the requirement directly.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block 'heat_treatment' field from '--' to 'PER NOTE N1' or equivalent so the requirement is unambiguous."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"⌀16"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"8"}],"comment":"Dimensions D1 (⌀16) and D12 (8) define the guide pin's shaft diameters, which are functional mating features, yet neither carries a fit or tolerance callout. Without specified tolerances on these guiding surfaces, the fit in the mating hole is undefined and the pin may not function as a guide. The designer should add appropriate fit tolerances (e.g., g6, h7) to both diameters.","recommended_correction":"Add ISO fit or explicit tolerance callouts to dimensions D1 and D12 to control the guide pin's mating fit."}]}
